--recursion-strategy.help: Recursion strategy: "default" for a redirect based, and "greedy" to recurse on all matches

--replay-proxy.help: Replay matched requests using this proxy.

--request.help: File containing the raw http request

--request-proto.help: Protocol to use along with raw request

--sa.help: Stop on all error cases. Implies -sf and -se.

--search.help: Search for a FFUFHASH payload from ffuf history

--sf.help: Stop when > 95% of responses return 403 Forbidden

--sni.help: Target TLS SNI, does not support FUZZ keyword

-D.help: DirSearch wordlist compatibility mode. Used in conjunction with -e flag. (default: false)

-H.help: Header "Name: Value", separated by colon. Multiple -H flags are accepted.

-acc.help: Custom auto-calibration string. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac

-acs.help: Custom auto-calibration strategies. Can be used multiple times. Implies -ac

-audit-log.help: Write audit log containing all requests, responses and config

-b.help: Cookie data "NAME1=VALUE1; NAME2=VALUE2" for copy as curl functionality.

-cc.help: Client cert for authentication. Client key needs to be defined as well for this to work

-ck.help: Client key for authentication. Client certificate needs to be defined as well for this to work

-compressed.help: Dummy flag for copy as curl functionality (ignored) (default true)

-debug-log.help: Write all of the internal logging to the specified file.

-e.help: Comma separated list of extensions. Extends FUZZ keyword.

-fc.help: Filter HTTP status codes from response. Comma separated list of codes and ranges

-fl.help: Filter by amount of lines in response. Comma separated list of line counts and ranges

-fmode.help: Filter set operator. Either of: and, or (default: or)

-fs.help: Filter HTTP response size. Comma separated list of sizes and ranges

-ft.help: Filter by number of milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. EG: >100 or <100

-fw.help: Filter by amount of words in response. Comma separated list of word counts and ranges

-ignore-body.help: Do not fetch the response content. (default: false)

-input-cmd.help: Command producing the input. --input-num is required when using this input method. Overrides -w.

-input-num.help: Number of inputs to test. Used in conjunction with --input-cmd. (default: 100)

-input-shell.help: Shell to be used for running command

-json.help: JSON output, printing newline-delimited JSON records (default: false)

-maxtime.help: Maximum running time in seconds for entire process. (default: 0)

-maxtime-job.help: Maximum running time in seconds per job. (default: 0)

-mc.help: Match HTTP status codes, or "all" for everything. (default: 200-299,301,302,307,401,403,405,500)

-ml.help: Match amount of lines in response

-mmode.help: Matcher set operator. Either of: and, or (default: or)

-mode.help: Multi-wordlist operation mode. Available modes: clusterbomb, pitchfork, sniper (default: clusterbomb)

-mt.help: Match how many milliseconds to the first response byte, either greater or less than. EG: >100 or <100

-mw.help: Match amount of words in response

-noninteractive.help: Disable the interactive console functionality (default: false)

-od.help: Directory path to store matched results to.

-of.help: Output file format. Available formats: json, ejson, html, md, csv, ecsv (or, 'all' for all formats) (default: json)

-or.help: Don't create the output file if we don't have results (default: false)

-p.help: Seconds of delay between requests, or a range of random delay. For example "0.1" or "0.1-2.0"

-postflight.help: Raw HTTP request file to run after each fuzzing request (repeatable, order matters)

-postflight-var.help: Extract a variable from the preceding -postflight response: "NAME:regex" (repeatable)

-preflight.help: Raw HTTP request file to run before each fuzzing request (repeatable, order matters)

-preflight-var.help: Extract a variable from the preceding -preflight response: "NAME:regex" (repeatable)

-recursion.help: Scan recursively. Only FUZZ keyword is supported, and URL (-u) has to end in it. (default: false)

-recursion-strategy.help: "default" for a redirect based, and "greedy" to recurse on all matches (default: default)

-replay-proxy.help: Replay matched requests using this proxy.

-request.help: File containing the raw http request

-request-proto.help: Protocol to use along with raw request (default: https)

-s.help: Do not print additional information (silent mode) (default: false)

-sa.help: Stop on all error cases. Implies -sf and -se. (default: false)

-search.help: Search for a FFUFHASH payload from ffuf history

-sf.help: Stop when > 95% of responses return 403 Forbidden (default: false)

-sni.help: Target TLS SNI, does not support FUZZ keyword

-v.help: Verbose output, printing full URL and redirect location (if any) with the results. (default: false)

-w.help: Wordlist file path and (optional) keyword separated by colon. eg. '/path/to/wordlist:KEYWORD'

-x.help: Proxy URL (SOCKS5 or HTTP). For example: http://127.0.0.1:8080 or socks5://127.0.0.1:8080
